Each operator belongs to one of the elementary **families** of the [operator algebra](language.qmd) &mdash; Lateral, Aggregate, Broadcast, Exchange, Field, Rewire, Structural (Divide and Die) and Seed; the logo marks which. The runtime also exposes a **field** kind, a field&rsquo;s own self-update.
